This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Hacha Chacha arrived at MACC as a stray with no known history. It is reported that Hacha will escalate to lunging, charging, baring teeth, and growling. While in care, Hacha has been observed to leash bite, thrash while on leash, and growl at handlers. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experinced adult only home.
